parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Use the definition of power to show that the SI base units of power are $\mathrm{kg\,m^2\,s^{-3}}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: The intensity $I$ of a sound wave moving through a gas is given by $$I = f^2 A^2 v k$$ where $f$ is the frequency of the wave, $A$ is the amplitude of the wave, $v$ is the speed of the wave and $k$ is a constant that depends on the gas.
parts.text: Determine the SI base units of $k$.

marking_points.text: work done per unit time or energy transferred per unit time
intensity = power / area so SI base units of $I$ are $\mathrm{kg\,s^{-3}}$
$k = I / (f^2 A^2 v)$ so units of $k$ are $\mathrm{kg\,s^{-3} / (s^{-2} \times m^2 \times m\,s^{-1})}$
